description: This Java source file defines the VerifyPickServices class, which provides static methods for verifying and completing pick operations within a shipment verification process in the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: VerifyPickServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for verifying individual and bulk items, completing, and canceling pick verification sessions.

methods.name: verifySingleItem
methods.description: Verifies a single item in the pick session, creating a row in the session if quantity is provided.

methods.name: verifyBulkItem
methods.description: Verifies multiple items in bulk, creating rows for each selected item with a positive quantity.

methods.name: completeVerifiedPick
methods.description: Completes the pick verification process, finalizing the shipment and clearing all session rows.

methods.name: cancelAllRows
methods.description: Cancels all current pick verification session rows.
